projects.name: SPC Online Academy - Medical LMS (Next.js)
achievements: Built a medical LMS with Next.js (App Router), React 19, and Zustand, with public, student, and instructor areas
Built a custom HLS video player with quality options, resume playback, and subtitles, plus video content protection (watermark and leak tracing)
Managed app state with Zustand (instant updates with rollback) and added Arabic/English support with RTL/LTR switching
Built JWT auth (silent refresh, roles, route guards) and a checkout with card, wallet, cash outlet, and bank installments
Improved performance to a 96/100 Lighthouse score (LCP 0.9s, FCP 0.4s, CLS 0.028), and set up SEO and GTM/GA4 tracking

projects.name: Almasry Pharmacy - ECommerce PWA
achievements: Built 100+ custom UI components and 50+ Peregrine talons on a Magento PWA Studio storefront for an Arabic/RTL pharmacy
Built a checkout with 7 payment methods (Braintree, Apple Pay, Checkout.com, Tamara, Tabby, valU, COD), split-order support, and cart recovery on failed payments
Added an RxJS event system so late-loading analytics and UI still receive earlier events, feeding the GA4 dataLayer
Added Arabic/English support with RTL/LTR handling and store-view switching that detects Arabic input at runtime
Improved image loading with a Cloudflare/backend pipeline (WebP/JPG/PNG) and set up a Workbox service worker for faster loads and offline support

projects.name: Etlala - Fashion Marketplace (Magento 2)
achievements: Extended Magento 2 frontend using Layout XML, PHTML, RequireJS for multiple modules
Built reusable UI components across the platform
Developed complex marketplace workflows: subscriptions, seller states, plan upgrades
Supported multi-store AR/EN with RTL/LTR layouts and improved UX with AJAX pagination & dynamic loaders
Completed a practical training program focused on modern Magento 2 frontend development
Worked with Page Builder, widgets, layout XML, PHTML templates, and static assets
Gained experience with RequireJS, Git workflows, and converting Figma designs into UI components
Built responsive web applications using React.js, Bootstrap, and ES6 JavaScript, focusing on clean, modular code
